article.story: DEKALB, Ill. -- — Max Weisbrod’s 14 points helped Northern Illinois defeat Clarke 82-43 on Wednesday. Weisbrod added five assists for the Huskies (2-2). Brayden Gross scored 12 points and added 10 rebounds. David Douglas Jr. shot 4 for 12 to finish with nine points. Jonovan Howard finished with 10 points for the Pride. Clarke also got nine points from Ivan Vukusic. Malachi Rice also had seven points and two steals. Up next Northern Illinois: visits Bellarmine on Saturday. Clarke: visits South Dakota on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
